Then per order the event records the order status old→prepare-shipment, the shipped-line detail {sku, qty, location} for every line, and shelf old→null. · negative: the payload carries no** line-status field and no OUTBOUNDED value — outbound is order-level [BR-22].
Then** each SKU@location records on_hand_qty old→new with a negative delta referencing the outbound event.

when: When a bulk button is double-clicked.
then: Then the rejected attempt persists with the key and the original event id. · negative:** no second batch event exists.

when: When a label prints and, separately, a printer is offline.
then: Then** the first job records queued→sent→done with agent id, printer id, and artifact_type = shipping_label; the second records failed with a reason.

when: When an order's first line reaches INBOUNDED on View Orders.
then: Then** ready_at persists for that order with trigger set.

when: When an MKT order is imported on Order Management with no stock.
then: Then** the event persists with the import ref, PIC, rto_visible_at, and inbound_state_at_surface reflecting "none inbounded".

when: When the last line of a JIT order is inbounded.
then: Then** fully_inbounded_at and staging_shelf persist and the badge appears.

when: When a batch of 5 yields 3 success and 2 excluded.
then: Then 5 per-order results persist — one for every requested order, including the ones the all-success UI never mentions. · negative:** none is omitted.

when: When telemetry logging is enabled.
then: Then tab switches and search queries land in the analytics tier and not in the [G-8] audit stream. · negative:** with logging disabled, no audit-stream row is created and nothing else changes.

when: When 3 rows are selected via 7 checkbox clicks and a batch runs.
then: Then exactly one event carries the resolved 3-order selection and zero toggle events exist [NE-1]. · negative.**
Then** each outbounded order records processing→prepare-shipment with reason = bulk_outbound and the batch id, alongside (not instead of) [DC-9].
Then** each reservation records reserved_qty old→new against the shipment, distinct from the on-hand decrement [DC-10].

when: When the batch contains an MKT order with a non-inbounded line, a hold order, and an empty order.
then: Then** three exclusions persist with lines_not_inbounded, status_forbids_outbound, and empty_order, and the toast subtext reproduces them clause-for-clause in enum order — 3 excluded — 1 items not inbounded · 1 status blocks outbound · 1 no line items — so the persisted reasons and the operator-visible reasons cannot drift apart §3.4 step 6.

when: When a stale order is submitted.
then: Then** the rejection persists with expected_version→actual_version and changed_fields[], and no write occurred for that order.

when: When two batches overlap.
then: Then** the conflict persists with both batch ids, the overlapping order ids, and the winner.

when: When the print agent is offline for a batch.
then: Then** the batch-level failure persists with failed_job_count and drives the separate red toast.

when: When Refresh is clicked on the JIT tab.
then: Then** the snapshot persists with trigger = refresh, view_tab = jit, and the served order ids.

when: When an order is outbounded.
then: Then** left_at, reason = outbounded, and dwell_seconds (against [DC-13]) persist.

given: Given the session dies mid-batch. **
then: Then** the abort persists with the last completed sequence, cause, the committed order ids, and the not-attempted ids.

when: When a row 🖨 is clicked on an order with no carrier.
then: Then the refusal persists with reason = no_carrier and source = row_button, and it is distinguishable from a [DC-12] failed job because no job was ever created. · negative:** no label.printed event exists for that order.

title: Open the import modal from the filter bar
given: Given the live wireframe is loaded and window.__qaSentinel = 'om'

then: Then #m-import has class open, its header text starts with Marketing Order Import, window.__qaSentinel === 'om', and no .gtoast node exists yet.

title: Open the import modal from the wf-bar
given: Given the live wireframe is loaded
when: When I click .wf-bar button[data-modal="m-import"] (label Modal: Marketing Import)
then: Then #m-import has class open, and document.getElementById('m-import').querySelector('.modal').innerHTML is string-identical to the value the same expression returns after opening via QA-IMP-01's filter-bar button (§8.0 rule 6).

title: Step 1 copy
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read the first step block
then: Then it contains the bold label 1. Template, a button labelled ⬇ Download Template (.xlsx) with class btn-line, and the helper text Standard form from the dev team — Recipient · Contact · Address · Country · SKU · Qty · Campaign name.

title: Template download persists [DC-1]
given: Given the real admin import modal is open
when: When I click ⬇ Download Template (.xlsx)
then: Then an .xlsx file downloads and [DC-1] import.template_downloaded persists with my actor id, the timestamp, and the template version.

title: Order Type default state
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read the second step block
then: Then #otChipSeed has class on and text Influencer Seeding, #otChipCustom has text ✎ Custom and no on class, and #otCustom has style.display === 'none'.

title: Order Type custom toggle and focus
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I click #otChipCustom
then: Then #otChipCustom has class on, #otChipSeed does not, #otCustom has style.display === 'inline-block' with placeholder Enter type (e.g. Pop-up event giveaway), and document.activeElement === document.getElementById('otCustom').

title: Toggling back hides the custom input but keeps its value
given: Given #otChipCustom is active and I have typed Pop-up event giveaway into #otCustom
when: When I click #otChipSeed
then: Then #otCustom.style.display === 'none', #otChipSeed has class on, and #otCustom.value === 'Pop-up event giveaway' (retained but ignored, §3.2.2).

title: PIC defaults and helper copy
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read the third step block
then: Then the PIC <select> has Yongwon Ryu (me) selected among options Yongwon Ryu (me), Harshit, EuJin, Adinda; #picCustomBtn reads ✎ Custom; #picCustomIn has style.display === 'none' and placeholder Enter PIC name; and the helper text reads Default = logged-in user · Recorded as the PIC for this entire import — shown in the order list & RTO.

title: PIC custom toggle and focus
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I click #picCustomBtn
then: Then #picCustomIn.style.display === 'inline-block' and document.activeElement === document.getElementById('picCustomIn') And when I click #picCustomBtn again, #picCustomIn.style.display === 'none'.

title: Upload step copy
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read the fourth step block
then: Then it contains the bold label 4. Upload and a .dropzone whose text is 📄 Drag the completed template here or click to upload.

title: Preview header format
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read the preview header, located as document.querySelector('#m-import table.tbl').previousElementSibling (the <b> immediately preceding the preview table)
then: Then that element is a <b> and its textContent reads exactly Preview — mkt_seeding_batch3.xlsx · 12 rows parsed · 0 errors.

title: Preview table headers
given: Given #m-import is open with annotations shown (the §8.0 default)
when: When I read #m-import thead th in order, taking each cell's own text per §8.0 rule 5c — th.firstChild.textContent, which excludes the <span class="dot"> the annotated cell carries
then: Then #m-import thead th has length 7 and the seven values are Recipient, Country, SKU, Product Name, Qty, Campaign, Carrier (auto) And the raw textContent of the seventh cell is Carrier (auto)M1b, because that cell is <th class="anno"> and contains the M1b annotation dot — the dot is intentional chrome (QA-GBL-11, _wireframe-fixes §E) and its presence is not a defect.

title: Brand-bold product names [G-6]
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read the Product Name cells
then: Then row 1 contains Dr.Jart+ followed by Cicapair Gentle Cleansing Foam, row 2 contains Dr.Jart+ followed by Cicapair Sleepair Mask, and row 3 contains innisfree followed by Green Tea Seed Hyaluronic Serum.

title: Connected-carrier rendering [L-M1b]
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read the last cell of every row whose Country cell is GB
then: Then each contains exactly YunExpress with computed colour rgb(25, 135, 84) and font-weight 700.

title: Unconnected carrier blocks the whole file [L-M1b] [E-7] [G-17] (rewritten 2026-08-04 — it previously asserted the superseded "does not block" behaviour)
given: Given #m-import is open in its default state (the clean preview)
when: When I close the modal, click the wf-bar toggle #impPreviewToggle, and reopen #m-import — the unconnected preview (WF-16b, wireframe-only chrome)
then: Then the row whose Recipient is Lucia Ramos and whose Country is PE carries YunExpress with computed colour rgb(25, 135, 84), #mktBlock is display: none, and #mktConfirm has neither disabled nor aria-disabled="true" Then #mktPECell reads exactly Cannot import — no connected carrier with computed colour rgb(220, 53, 69) and font-weight 700 And #mktBlock is display: block and reads exactly Cannot import — these countries have no connected carrier: PE. Ask the fulfillment team to connect them, or remove those rows and upload again. And #mktConfirm carries both disabled and aria-disabled="true" — one unconnected row refuses the entire file, and no order is created [G-17].

title: Confirm button label format
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read #mktConfirm
then: Then its text is exactly Confirm Import (12 orders) and it carries class btn-mkt.

title: Confirm toast text, colour, dismissal and no reload [E-43] [E-45]
given: Given #m-import is open and window.__qaSentinel = 'om'
when: When I click #mktConfirm
then: Then #m-import no longer has class open And #gtoast exists with display not none, position: fixed, top: 16px, right: 16px, computed background rgb(25, 135, 84) And its first text node is ✓ Confirmed — 12 orders imported and its <small> reads Carrier auto-assigned per country · 1 not connected — flagged to contact Fulfillment Center And after ~2 600 ms #gtoast has display: none And window.__qaSentinel === 'om' — the page did not reload [G-2].

title: Modal note copy (BR-1 in operator-visible form)
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read .note.mkt
then: Then it reads exactly On confirm, orders are created as MKT- orders and appear immediately in Ready to be Outbonded (Marketing view) regardless of stock or inbound status. — including the preserved spelling Outbonded.

title: No stock-error copy anywhere in the modal [E-20]
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I search #m-import for the case-insensitive substrings out of stock, not in the warehouse, insufficient
then: Then none is present, and the only occurrence of stock in #m-import is inside .note.mkt (§3.2.7), in the phrase regardless of stock or inbound status (BR-1, R-2). (No Korean-language token is searched for. §2.2 declares that no Korean string exists anywhere on this page, so a Korean "stock" probe could never match: it would assert nothing and would contradict the spec's own declaration. Korean-copy regression belongs to a page that renders Korean [G-6].)

title: No print, scan, or carrier-picker affordance in the modal
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I enumerate #m-import button, #m-import input, #m-import select
then: Then no button label contains Print, no input has type="file" or a scan role, and the only <select> is the PIC picker — there is no carrier <select> anywhere (BR-3, BR-28, BR-29).

title: Non-xlsx upload rejected [E-1]
given: Given the real admin import modal is open
when: When I upload orders.csv
then: Then an inline error reads Unsupported file — upload the .xlsx template., no preview renders, Confirm Import stays disabled, and [DC-2] import.file_uploaded persists with parse outcome rejected_format.

title: A row error blocks the whole file [E-3] [E-19]
given: Given the real admin import modal is open
when: When I upload a 12-row file where row 4 has an empty Country
then: Then the preview header reads … · 12 rows parsed · 1 errors, row 4 shows its reason, Confirm Import is disabled, and [DC-3] import.file_parsed persists the per-row error reason (BR-12, [PD-57 · OWNER-PENDING]).

title: Zero-stock SKU must NOT block [E-20]
given: Given the real admin import modal is open
when: When I upload a file whose every SKU has stock 0 and no inbound history, and then click Confirm Import
then: Then no error was raised, Confirm Import was enabled, and after the confirm all orders exist and are listed in the RTO Marketing view (BR-1). Regression guard for R-2.

title: Empty custom order type blocks confirm [E-14]
given: Given a valid file is parsed with 0 errors
when: When I click ✎ Custom in Step 2 and leave #otCustom empty
then: Then Confirm Import is disabled and the inline message reads Enter an order type.

title: Empty custom PIC blocks confirm [E-15]
given: Given a valid file is parsed with 0 errors
when: When I click ✎ Custom in Step 3 and type only whitespace into the PIC custom input
then: Then Confirm Import is disabled and the inline message reads Enter a PIC name.

title: Zero data rows blocks confirm [E-2] [E-63]
given: Given the real admin import modal is open
when: When I upload a valid template containing headers but no data rows
then: Then the preview header reads … · 0 rows parsed · 0 errors, Confirm Import is disabled, and no empty batch is created.

title: Confirm persists the whole batch chain [DC-6] [DC-9] [DC-10] [DC-11] [DC-12]
given: Given a valid 12-row file with 11 GB rows and 1 PE row, order type Influencer Seeding, PIC Yongwon Ryu (me)
when: When I click Confirm Import (12 orders)
then: Then exactly 12 orders exist with MKT- numbers And [DC-6] import.batch_confirmed persists with batch id, filename, file hash, order_count=12, order type, PIC, carriers_assigned=11, carrier_unresolved=1, idempotency key And 12 [DC-9] order.created events persist with recipient, contact, address, country, SKU, qty, product-name snapshot, campaign and batch id And 11 [DC-10] order.carrier_assigned events persist with old=null → new=YunExpress And 1 [DC-11] order.carrier_unresolved persists with country=PE, reason=no_connected_carrier And 12 [DC-12] order.pic_assigned events persist with the batch PIC.

title: Double-click creates one batch [E-11] [DC-28]
given: Given a valid file is parsed
when: When I click Confirm Import twice within 200 ms
then: Then exactly one batch exists, exactly {n} orders were created, and one [DC-28] idempotency.duplicate_suppressed persists naming import.batch_confirmed [G-9].

title: Network failure is atomic [E-12] [DC-7]
given: Given a valid file is parsed
when: When I click Confirm Import and the network drops after the request is sent
then: Then either all {n} orders exist or none do — never a partial batch And a red toast is shown, and [DC-7] import.batch_rejected persists when the server rejected it.

title: Duplicate file warns, does not block [E-10] [DC-4] [DC-5]
given: Given mkt_seeding_batch3.xlsx was already confirmed as batch B-1042
when: When I upload the identical file and click Confirm Import
then: Then a dialog titled This file was already imported appears with a body naming batch B-1042 and buttons Cancel and Import anyway And [DC-4] import.duplicate_file_warned persists And choosing Import anyway creates the batch and persists [DC-5] import.duplicate_file_overridden [PD-58 · OWNER-PENDING].

title: Abandoning the modal creates nothing [E-13] [DC-8]
given: Given a valid file has been uploaded and previewed
when: When I click Cancel
then: Then no orders are created, [DC-8] import.batch_abandoned persists with reason user_closed, and [DC-2] and [DC-3] remain persisted (§3.2.4).

title: Ambiguous carrier mapping aborts the batch [E-52]
given: Given the configuration maps GB to two connected carriers
when: When I click Confirm Import
then: Then no orders are created, a red toast names GB, and [DC-7] persists with reason ambiguous_carrier_mapping.

title: Post-import list behaviour [E-45] [E-57]
given: Given the header reads 2,818 orders and a date filter plus page 2 are active
when: When a 12-order import is confirmed
then: Then the header reads 2,830 orders, 12 new purple MKT- rows are present, the applied filter and page number are unchanged, and no page reload occurred And the 12 rows now visible are exactly the 12 orders written by that batch's [DC-9] order.created events — the list is a view over them, so their count and their order numbers match one-for-one.

title: Export egress is recorded [DC-26] [DC-27]
given: Given a filter set is applied
when: When I click ⬇ Export and then ⬇ Yun Export
then: Then [DC-26] orders.exported and [DC-27] orders.yun_exported each persist with the filter context and the row count, and neither shows a toast (§3.13).

title: Preview collapse row spans the full table — re-baselined on [WF-15 · proposed], applied 2026-08-03
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I read #m-import tbody td[colspan]
then: Then exactly one such cell exists, its text is ⋯ +8 more rows, and its colspan attribute is 7, equal to the length of #m-import thead th And the collapse row therefore spans the full table (§3.2.4). title: Preview row arithmetic matches the header count
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I count the data rows
then: Then 4 named rows are rendered (Svetlana Jaloba, Zoe Garner, Mariana Maheha, Lucia Ramos) plus one collapse row reading ⋯ +8 more rows, so 4 + 8 = 12, consistent with the header's 12 rows parsed.

title: The dropzone is inert in the mock (demo limitation, not a defect)
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I click .dropzone
then: Then no file picker opens, no input[type=file] exists anywhere in the document, and the preview is unchanged — the preview data is static (_wireframe-fixes §E). All parse-behaviour scenarios are therefore [ADMIN].

title: Modal geometry and dismissal controls
given: Given #m-import is open
when: When I inspect #m-import .modal
then: Then it carries classes modal wide, its max-width computes to 720px, its header exposes a ✕ control matching header .x[data-close], and its footer contains exactly two buttons, Cancel and Confirm Import (12 orders).

title: Repeated confirms reuse one toast node
given: Given I have clicked #mktConfirm once and have not touched #sampCancelBtn
when: When I reopen #m-import and click #mktConfirm again
then: Then document.querySelectorAll('.gtoast').length === 1 and its id is gtoast — no second node is created for the same action (contrast [WF-18 · proposed], which is about two different actions).

title: Country given as a full name [E-67]
